name: Senkawa Nozomi
source:
A teacher at Tsukigasaki’s Kindergarten who has a very good relationship with her students. She also serves as [url=/c17038]Rinne's[/url] mentor there.

[spoiler]She is a powerful Elfin working for Valhalla. Unlike most Elfin she specializes in two runes: psy-missing (which allows her to hide her identity to other Elfin) and hypno. [/spoiler]
